Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public.

Indian  Standard 

SPECIFICATION  FOR 

HEXAGON  HANDLES  FOR  PLAIN  AND 

THREADED  PLUG  GAUGES 

(  Second  Revision  ) 


(  Reaffirmed  1998) 


1.  Scope  —  Covers  requirements  for  Hexagon  handles  for  plain  and  threaded  plug  gauges  for  diameters 
up  to  250  mm  and  200  mm  respectively. 

2.  Dimensions 

2.1   For  size  range  of  gauging  members  up  to  40  mm  or  M  40r  taper  lock  type    handles,  double  ended, 
conforming  to  the  dimensions  given  in  Table  1  are  recommended.

IS  :5388  -  1983 

2.2  For  size  range  of  gauging  members  above  40  up  to  and  including  65  mm  for  plain  and  above 
M40  up  to  and  including  M65  for  threaded,  double  ended  trilock  fastening  type  handles  conforming  to 
the  dimensions  given  in  Table  2  are  recommended. 

2.3  For  size  range  of  gauging  members  above  65  up  to  and  including  250  mm  for  plain  and  above  M65 
up  to  and  including  M200  for  threaded,  single  ended  trilock  fastening  type  handles  conforming  to  the 
dimensions  given  in  Table  2  are  recommended. 

2.4  The  dimensions  of  the  hexagon  socket  cheese  head  screw  required  for  the  trilock  fastening 
type  handles  both  single  and  double  ended,  shall  be  as  given  in  Table  3. 

3.  Material  —  Wrought  aluminium  and  aluminium  alloys  conforming  to  Designation  63400 
of  IS  "  733-1975  '  Specification  for  wrought  aluminium  and  aluminium  alloy  bars,  rods  and  sections 
(  for  general  engineering  purposes  )  (  second  revision  )  \ 

3.1   Non-metaliic  handles  with  metallic  inserts  on  fastening  position  may  also  be  used. 

4.  General   Requirements 

4.1  The  hexagon  socket  cheese  head  screw  shall  conform  to  Grade  A  of  IS:  1367  (Part2)-1979 
'  Technical  supply  conditions  for  threaded  steel,  fasteners  :  Part  2  Product  grades  and  tolerance  (  second 
revision  )  '  and  property  class  4.6  of  IS  :  1367  (  Part  3  )-1979  '  Technical  supply  conditions  for  threaded 
steel  fasteners:  Part  3  Mechanical  properties  and  test  methods  for  bolts,  screws  and  studs  with  full 
loadability  (  second  revision  )  '. 

5.  Workmanship  and  Finish 

5.1  Workmanship  shall  give  good  degree  of  rigidity  to  the  assembled  unit  and  shall  provide  complete 
interchangeability.  All  sharp  edges  shaN  be  rounded. 

5.2  The  external  surfaces  of  the  handles  shall    be   smooth    and   shall  have   a  bright  or  anodized  finish. 

6.  Designation 

6.1  The  handles  shall  be  designated  by  the  handle  number  and  the  number  of  this  standard. 

Examples  : 

1)  A  taper  lock  handle  No.  7  shall  be  designated  as: 

Handle  No.  7  IS  :  5388 

2)  A  trilock  fastening  type  double  ended  handle  No.  8  shall  be  designated  as* 

Handle  No.  8  IS  :  5388 

3)  A  trilock. fastening  type  single  ended  handle  No.  9  for  GO  gauge  shall  be  designated  as* 

Handle  No.  9  IS  :  5388 

4)  A  trilock  fastening  type  single  ended  handle  No.  10forfsl0  GO  gauge  shall  be  designated  as- 

Handle  No.  10  IS  :  5388 

6.2  The  hexagon  socket  cheese  head  screw  required  for  the  trilock  fastening  type  handles  shall  be 
designated  by  the  size  t/a  length  and  the  number  of  this  standard. 

Example: 

A   hexagon   socket   cheese    head   screw   with    d2   as    M12XV25,    length   45    mm   shall  be 
designated  as: 

7.  Marking  —  The  following  shall  be  marked  on  the  handles: 

a)  Handle  number; 

b)  Manufacturer's  name  or  trade-mark,  (if  any);  and 

c)  Any  other  marking  specified  in  the  reievent  Indian  Standards  on  plug  gauges. 

7.1   iSI  Certrffcation  Marking  —  Details  available  with  the  Indian  Standards  Institution. 

8.  Packing  —  Shall  be  suitably  packed  to  prevent  damage  during  transit.

IS  :  5388  -  1983

EXPLANATORY     NOTE 

This  standard  was  originally  published  in  1969.  First  revision  was  brought  out  in  1980  on  the 
basis  of  ISO  3670-1979  '  Blanks  for  plug  gauges  and  handles  (taper  lock  and  trilock)  and  ring  gauges- 
Design  and  general  dimensions  ',  issued  by  the  International  Organization  for  Standardization. 

This  standard  has  now  been  revised  again  to  bring  it  in  line  with  the  latest  manufacturing  prac- 
tices followed  in  India.  Modifications  have  been  made  in  requirements  for  dimensions,  designation  and 
marking,  in  addition,  the  scope  of  tha  standard  has  been  extended  to  cover  handles  for  threaded  plug 
gauges  of  sizes  up  to  and  including  M200. 


Reprography  Unit,  BIS,  New  Delhi,  India
